Animal · 2 hexes · SM +1 Panther [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: mundane land animals; answers Panther (SRD 5.1)]

A black leopard that hunts from above and is never seen beforehand. It works the canopy over a trail, drops onto whoever is walking last, and is gone up the trunk again with the body before the front of the column has turned round. Silence is most of what makes it dangerous.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/panther.gct
  • Independent build total: 30 points of racial traits plus 24 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Panther (SRD 5.1). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Movement: ground Move 6, 9 at a sprint (primary). The published Move folds this creature's Enhanced Move into a single figure.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
